Title: The store settings blade has a Product Comparison group with three settings; a saved value reaches the storefront after a reload
Preconditions: Back office, administrator @td(ADMIN_DEFAULT.userName) (the sign-in name; the alias email is informational and does not sign in) (password key ADMIN_PASSWORD typed by the lane). Sources: published guide for VCST-5918 (Configuration › Stores › the store › Settings widget › Product Comparison group), module README §Settings at tag 3.1000.0 {SPEC}; labels from the module's own localization {OBSERVED}. NEEDS_WINDOW: the case changes 'Products per category' on the shared store and restores the value it found (recorded in GROUP_ROWS — 5 on a store at defaults).
Steps:
[AUTH] sign in to adminUrl as an administrator
[NAV] open Configuration › Stores
[ACT] open the store {{STORE_ID}}
[ACT] click the 'Settings' widget
[WAIT] the settings blade renders
[ACT] open the 'Product Comparison' group
[KEY] record the settings listed in the group as GROUP_ROWS (title, control type, current value)
[ACT] set 'Products per category' to 3
[ACT] click 'Save'
[WAIT] the save completes
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/stores/{{STORE_ID}} and read the setting ProductComparison.MaxItems as SAVED
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/compare in a storefront session after a hard reload
[KEY] read pageContext.store.settings.modules from the storefront's GetPageContext response ({OBSERVED} (vcptcore 2026-11-23, REG-2026-11-23-0130)) for the module VirtoCommerce.ProductComparison as PUBLIC_SETTINGS
Assertions:
[REL] GROUP_ROWS lists exactly 'Enable product comparison', 'Products per category' and 'Allow guests to compare' {SPEC} {OBSERVED} (published guide screenshot, vcptcore 2026-11-19)
[STATE] before the change the three rows show the defaults: Enable on, Products per category 5, Allow guests on {OBSERVED} (vcptcore 2026-11-20, REG-2026-11-20-1202; README §Settings)
[MATH] SAVED = 3 {OBSERVED} (vcptcore 2026-11-20, REG-2026-11-20-1202)
[MATH] PUBLIC_SETTINGS.MaxItems = 3 — the setting is public and reaches the storefront without a deploy {OBSERVED} (vcptcore 2026-11-20, REG-2026-11-20-1202; README: the per-store settings are marked public)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[CONSOLE] no TypeError or JS error in the Admin blade
[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx on the Admin API calls the blade issues
Failure_Signals: A setting missing from the group, a wrong default, the saved value not stored, the storefront still using the old value after a reload, the module setting not restored after a failure
Cleanup: [AUTH] set 'Products per category' back to the value GROUP_ROWS recorded and Save; re-read ProductComparison.MaxItems

Title: 'Reset to default' on a modified Product Comparison setting returns the store to inheriting the default
Preconditions: Back office, administrator @td(ADMIN_DEFAULT.userName) (the sign-in name; the alias email is informational and does not sign in) (password key ADMIN_PASSWORD typed by the lane). Sources: published guide for VCST-5918 (Configuration › Stores › the store › Settings widget › Product Comparison group), module README §Settings at tag 3.1000.0 {SPEC}; labels from the module's own localization {OBSERVED}. KNOWN BUG CANDIDATE (checklist X23, vcptcore 2026-11-17): the blade shows 'Reset to default: <value>' per modified setting, but it stores the default value instead of clearing the override (itHasValues stays true) and REST null is ignored — a store can never return to inheriting. The oracle is the label itself and the platform's store-settings model: reset means the override is removed {SPEC}. An expected FAIL is reported as a platform defect (Low), never made to pass by editing the expectation. NEEDS_WINDOW: modifies a store setting and restores it.
Steps:
[AUTH] sign in to adminUrl as an administrator
[NAV] open Configuration › Stores › the store › Settings widget › the 'Product Comparison' group
[ACT] set 'Products per category' to 4
[ACT] click 'Save'
[WAIT] the save completes
[ACT] reopen the 'Product Comparison' group
[ACT] click 'Reset to default' on 'Products per category'
[WAIT] the row shows the default value
[ACT] click 'Save'
[WAIT] the save completes
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/stores/{{STORE_ID}} and read the setting ProductComparison.MaxItems as AFTER_RESET (value, itHasValues)
Assertions:
[STATE] AFTER_RESET carries no stored override (itHasValues = false) and reads the declared default 5 {SPEC} (the 'Reset to default' control)
[DOM] after Reset and Save the 'Products per category' row no longer offers 'Reset to default' — it is at its default again, not merely holding the default value {SPEC}
Cross_Layer_Checks: [CONSOLE] no TypeError or JS error in the Admin blade
Failure_Signals: itHasValues stays true after Reset to default, the override cannot be removed
Cleanup: [AUTH] make sure 'Products per category' reads 5 (write 5 when an override remains)
